text:
SRE-Bot: [ALERT] region=eu-west-1 service=inference autoscale: queue_depth spike + throttle_events rising (tokens/sec saturation). severity=P1. paging maya :pager:

maya: acked, I'm oncall. looking at dashboards now.

priya: joining - seeing 429s for streaming/generation endpoints, customer errors correlate with the spike. which pool is this?

chris: eu-west-1 pool-rl-3; autoscaler attempted launches but k8s quota errors  -> pods stuck Pending, event: Insufficient resources.

maya: ok that explains failed scale. kicking off mitigations: 1) open temp capacity via dedicated spare pool (if available), 2) reduce burst threshold so we can shed non-critical background jobs, 3) adjust alerting to avoid noisy 1m spikes.

linh: quick note - we've seen this pattern when prefix caching misses + sudden customer batch submits. short-lived spikes should be smoothed by autoscaler policy but quota prevents scale.

maya: executing step 2 first. moving low-priority offline-batch queue to delayed. command: ```./opsctl move-queue --env=eu-west-1 --queue=background-embeddings --delay=30m```

maya: starting request-routing fallback to smaller model variant for latency-sensitive routes to reduce tokens/sec. runbook snippet: ```routeset update --region eu-west-1 --route=/v1/gen --fallback-model=redwood-small-1 --weight=0.5```

SRE-Bot: incident channel created: #inc-1755001234. linked runbook: https://wiki.redwood/ops/runbooks/autoscale-queue-depth

priya: checking customer impact - looks like 3 orgs had degraded latencies and some 429s (acct-8921, acct-1102, acct-7740). reaching out via status page now.

chris: infra team is requesting temporary quota bump for eu-west-1 (tickets open). ETA unknown. meanwhile we can migrate a small number of reserved pods from us-west-2 to eu-west-1 if network policy allows.

linh: suggestion: for alert tuning, change queue_depth alert to use 5m avg and require tokens/sec > 80% for 2 consecutive buckets before P1 fire. reduces noise from short blips.

maya: agreed. making those alert rule edits now. edited rule: `queue_depth > 2500 AND avg(tokens/sec,5m) > 0.8*capacity` -> severity=P1. old rule was queue_depth > 1500 (1m).

priya: also adding a suppression window for background-queue alerts for 10m after deploys to avoid deploy noise.

maya: executed fallback routing + delayed background jobs. starting a manual scale: `kubectl scale --replicas=+12 deploy/pool-rl-3 -n infra-eu` (temporary).

SRE-Bot: change: autoscaler attempts paused for 6m while manual scale completes.

chris: manual scale started, watching for pods becoming Ready. if Pending due to node quotas we'll have to reassign nodes.

maya: pods are becoming Ready, throttle events dropping. realtime metrics: tokens/sec dropped 40%, queue_depth coming down.

priya: customer update posted: "We're investigating elevated error rates in eu-west-1; mitigation in progress. No data loss." :white_check_mark:

linh: let's capture root signals for postmortem: prefix cache miss rate, sudden large-batch submits, quota preemption. will add to incident notes.

maya: we should also add a dashboard card for tokens/sec headroom + pending pod count. this would have helped earlier.

chris: created dashboard draft: https://dash.redwood/d/queues/eu-west-1-backpressure (added tokens/sec headroom, pending pods, avg queue_depth 1/5/15m).

maya: ok handoff: I'm going offline in 20m. will leave incident channel summary and tasks: - confirm manual scale stability for 1h - follow up on quota ticket - add runbook step to fallback to smaller model variant automatically when tokens/sec > 85% for 3m - create post-incident alert tuning PR.

priya: taking oncall. I'll monitor for 1h and follow up with infra on quota. thanks maya.

SRE-Bot: incident annotated: mitigated=true, impact=partial-degradation, affected_customers=[acct-8921,acct-1102,acct-7740], mitigation_actions=[manual-scale, fallback-routing, delayed-background-jobs].

maya: quick retrospective notes while fresh: make autoscaler tolerant to transient resource unavailability by allowing temporary overcommit of reserved nodes or preemptible fallback; add synthetic load test for large batch submits; tune queue_depth alert to 5m avg + tokens/sec cross-check.

linh: I'll open a JIRA: SRE-1283 "Autoscale quota-fallback & alert tuning" with tasks for dashboard, runbook edits, PR for alert rules.

priya: adding post-incident plan: 1) merge alert rule change (staging) 2) add dashboard alert for pending pods 3) update runbook with fallback-model steps 4) communicate to product about customers affected.

maya: thanks all. leaving notes in #inc-1755001234 and handing to priya. :thumbsup:

priya: acknowledged. will post a short incident summary in #incidents after stabilization.
